newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HEINEKEN OPENS 9.0 PCT DOWN AFTER WARNING.
newsitem.headline: HEINEKEN OPENS 9.0 PCT DOWN AFTER WARNING.

text.p: Shares in Dutch brewer Heineken NV opened 32.70 guilders or nine percent lower on Friday at 330.00 guilders after it announced lower than expected first half profits and warned profit for the full year 1996 would lag 1995's.

Heineken earlier announced first half net profit of 297 million guilders, up from 280 million in the same period a year earlier, but below even the lowest forecast which had ranged from 308 million to 322 million guilders.
Analysts said the market was shocked by the brewer's warning that it expected 1996 full year net profit to be "somewhat" lower than 1995's 664 million guilders.

"The expectation's the thing that's going to go against them, the figures weren't too awful," one analyst said, adding the market needed time to assess the reasons for Heineken's warning. By 0742 GMT Heineken shares were at 329.00 guilders. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
